# Will this migration take your database down?

> Paste a PostgreSQL migration to find statements that lock the table: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY, SET NOT NULL, a missing lock_timeout. No database connection.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
